soundness_flags.label: oeq:null-supported-converse
soundness_flags.one_line: Theta_n explicitly contains the zero-amplitude tuple, for which Delta_n(theta)=0, but H1(rho) is defined only for positive rho; thus the claimed every-theta alternative support H1(c_lb Delta_n(theta)) is undefined at that feasible tuple.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 793–816; abstract, Section 3 Theorem 1, and Section 4
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The article derives a minimax rate and attainability result for Hölder-smooth pointwise CATE estimation; it does not state a CATE-homogeneity testing radius.
The paper develops nonparametric tests including a no-CATE-heterogeneity null with asymptotic analysis, rather than a finite-sample Hölder minimax critical radius.
The paper tests quantitative and qualitative CATE heterogeneity using structured rule classes and supplies asymptotic linearity, power, and local weak-limit results.
The published duration-outcome article studies a homogeneous restricted-CATE null through asymptotic and bootstrap analysis, including fixed and root-n local alternatives.
The paper proposes propensity-reweighted multisample U-statistic tests for heterogeneity across observational strata and establishes asymptotic results.
The preprint tests the variance-zero CATE characterization with intra-fold splitting and reports asymptotic normality and type-I control under nuisance learner conditions.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Restrict the parameterwise prior construction to theta with Delta_n(theta)>0, retaining the zero tuple only to prove feasibility of the deterministic optimization.

Give an explicit finite signed-amplitude distribution realizing the zeta_2, zeta_3, zeta_4 constraints in the null-mixture handle before the likelihood expansion; this makes the proposed lower-bound route falsifiable independently of its envelope.
After the all-regime match, isolate at least one genuinely rough regime with a closed exponent and matching lower construction, alongside the already supplied no-penalty region.

recommended_next_step: Revise oeq:null-supported-converse to exclude the zero-separation tuple from its prior-support claim, then advance the otherwise novel fixed-sample minimax-frontier kernel to Stage 0.
